notes: Overnight preculture at 28 C with shaking, but the 1- and 15-day exposures ran 'at room temperature' (no number), so growth_temperature left out. Shaking during the 15-day exposure is not restated; culture_mode/oxygen inferred from the growth protocol. Day 1 stationary (study says stationary-phase cells), day 15 late_stationary (inferred, >24 h). Low-dose ionizing radiation from internal radionuclide sources added before inoculation: other_physical, exposure adapted. Both plain and FeCl3 non-irradiated controls are controls at each day. carbon_source glucose although 1% casamino acids are also present. WT re-read: WT DH10B, no plasmid -> wild_type. | 2026-11-20: day 15 moved from late_stationary to long_term_stationary (more than 72 h).

base_medium.q: M9 minimal medium supplemented with 0.5% glucose (Sigma-Aldrich), 1% thiamine hydrochloride (Spectrum), and 1% (w/v) casamino acids (Bacto)

medium_class.q: M9 minimal medium supplemented with 0.5% glucose (Sigma-Aldrich), 1% thiamine hydrochloride (Spectrum), and 1% (w/v) casamino acids (Bacto)

culture_mode.q: at 28°C and shaking at 215 rpm overnight

oxygen.q: at 28°C and shaking at 215 rpm overnight

inducer_added.q: subjected to an absorbed dose of 10 mGy d-1 of in situ Pu-239, H-3, or Fe-55 radionuclide source or non-irradiated chemical equivalent control

transcription_arrested.q: subjected to an absorbed dose of 10 mGy d-1 of in situ Pu-239, H-3, or Fe-55 radionuclide source or non-irradiated chemical equivalent control

mixed_organism.q: Comparative gene expression profiling analysis of RNA-seq data for E. coli DH10β cells

assay_class.q: Ribosomal RNA was removed from total RNA samples

rrna_removal.q: Ribosomal RNA was removed from total RNA samples using either Ribo-Zero rRNA Removal Kit Bacteria (Illumina) or RiboMinus Bacteria 2.0 Transcriptome Isolation Kit

growth_phase.q: characterize the global transcriptional response of stationary-phase E. coli
samples for RNA extration taken at one and 15-days after inoculation/spike addition

treatment.q: Non-irradiated controls either contained no additional chemical addition or an equimolar amount of stable FeCl3 (2.47uM)
subjected to an absorbed dose of 10 mGy d-1 of in situ Pu-239, H-3, or Fe-55 radionuclide source

exposure.q: Radionuclide sources were added to growth flasks prior to inoculation.
